packageRules.description: Never update this repository's references to ITSELF. workflow-templates/gitleaks.yml pins FlowMatrix-AI/.github by digest, and it cannot use a local './' ref the way .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml now does -- the Actions template picker copies that file verbatim into OTHER repos, where './.github/workflows/gitleaks.yml' would resolve to a file that does not exist. Left managed, Renovate bumps the pin to this repo's own new HEAD, which creates a new HEAD, which it bumps again next week: of the 11 commits before this rule, 8 were that self-chase (a 9th was an unrelated actions/checkout bump). Each one also reset renovate/stability-days on every downstream 'flowmatrix-ai/.github digest' PR in the org, so five of them sat pending for 45-54 days and could never reach the 3-day soak that gates automerge. The stale pin in the template is harmless: a repo that adopts the template gets its own Renovate, which pins it forward on first run.
